page.notes: Arabic lines transcribed from the scan with some uncertainty about diacritics and the honorific marks; the Arabic shahada line and the superscript word above "محمد" are doubtful. The "2" after "Deum," may be a reference mark rather than a numeral. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin are approximate at this resolution.
